sentences.hanzi: 十月十三日是重阳节。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyuè shísān rì shì Chóngyángjié.
sentences.english: October 13th is the Double Ninth Festival.

sentences.hanzi: 小明和丽丽陪爷爷奶奶去爬山。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì péi yéye nǎinai qù páshān.
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili accompanied Grandpa and Grandma to climb a mountain.

sentences.hanzi: 山路很长，他们走得很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Shānlù hěn cháng, tāmen zǒu de hěn màn.
sentences.english: The mountain path was very long, and they walked very slowly.

sentences.hanzi: 小明走累了，他说：“爷爷，我走不动了，我们休息一下吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng zǒu lèi le, tā shuō: "Yéye, wǒ zǒu bù dòng le, wǒmen xiūxi yīxià ba."
sentences.english: Xiaoming got tired from walking and said, "Grandpa, I can't walk anymore. Let's rest a bit."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷笑着说：“小明，你想听一个故事吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye xiào zhe shuō: "Xiǎomíng, nǐ xiǎng tīng yī gè gùshi ma?"
sentences.english: Grandpa smiled and said, "Xiaoming, do you want to hear a story?"

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“我想听！爷爷快讲吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ xiǎng tīng! Yéye kuài jiǎng ba."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "I want to hear it! Grandpa, tell it now."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷指着山顶说：“山顶上有一棵老松树。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye zhǐ zhe shāndǐng shuō: "Shāndǐng shàng yǒu yī kē lǎo sōngshù."
sentences.english: Grandpa pointed to the top of the mountain and said, "There is an old pine tree on the mountaintop."

sentences.hanzi: “那棵老松树已经活了几百年了。”
sentences.pinyin: "Nà kē lǎo sōngshù yǐjīng huó le jǐ bǎi nián le."
sentences.english: "That old pine tree has already lived for several hundred years."

sentences.hanzi: “每年重阳节，很多人都爬到山顶看它。”
sentences.pinyin: "Měi nián Chóngyángjié, hěn duō rén dōu pá dào shāndǐng kàn tā."
sentences.english: "Every year on the Double Ninth Festival, many people climb to the mountaintop to see it."

sentences.hanzi: “听说，能走到老松树旁边的人，会得到健康和快乐。”
sentences.pinyin: "Tīngshuō, néng zǒu dào lǎo sōngshù pángbiān de rén, huì dédào jiànkāng hé kuàilè."
sentences.english: "It is said that people who can make it to the old pine tree will gain health and happiness."

sentences.hanzi: 小明听了，眼睛亮了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng tīng le, yǎnjīng liàng le qǐlái.
sentences.english: After hearing this, Xiaoming's eyes lit up.

sentences.hanzi: 他站起来说：“爷爷，我也要去看老松树！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn qǐlái shuō: "Yéye, wǒ yě yào qù kàn lǎo sōngshù!"
sentences.english: He stood up and said, "Grandpa, I want to see the old pine tree too!"

sentences.hanzi: 他们又往前走。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yòu wǎng qián zǒu.
sentences.english: They continued walking forward.

sentences.hanzi: 山路两边有很多黄色的花，风很轻。
sentences.pinyin: Shānlù liǎngbiān yǒu hěn duō huángsè de huā, fēng hěn qīng.
sentences.english: There were many yellow flowers on both sides of the mountain path, and the wind was gentle.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽拉着奶奶的手，一步一步地走。
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì lā zhe nǎinai de shǒu, yī bù yī bù de zǒu.
sentences.english: Lili held Grandma's hand and walked step by step.

sentences.hanzi: 过了一会儿，他们到了山顶。
sentences.pinyin: Guò le yīhuìr, tāmen dào le shāndǐng.
sentences.english: After a while, they reached the mountaintop.

sentences.hanzi: 山顶上很美。
sentences.pinyin: Shāndǐng shàng hěn měi.
sentences.english: The top of the mountain was beautiful.

sentences.hanzi: 金色的菊花开了，一片一片的，像小小的太阳。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnsè de júhuā kāi le, yī piàn yī piàn de, xiàng xiǎo xiǎo de tàiyáng.
sentences.english: Golden chrysanthemums had bloomed in patches, like little suns.

sentences.hanzi: 小明看见那棵老松树，它又高又大，叶子还是绿的。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng kànjiàn nà kē lǎo sōngshù, tā yòu gāo yòu dà, yèzi hái shì lǜ de.
sentences.english: Xiaoming saw the old pine tree; it was tall and large, and its leaves were still green.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“小明，你看，你走到了这里，真棒！”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye shuō: "Xiǎomíng, nǐ kàn, nǐ zǒu dào le zhèlǐ, zhēn bàng!"
sentences.english: Grandpa said, "Xiaoming, look, you made it up here. Well done!"

sentences.hanzi: 小明开心地笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng kāixīn de xiào le.
sentences.english: Xiaoming smiled happily.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶拿出重阳糕，分给大家吃。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai ná chū Chóngyánggāo, fēn gěi dàjiā chī.
sentences.english: Grandma took out the Double Ninth cake and shared it with everyone.

sentences.hanzi: 重阳糕软软的、糯糯的，甜甜的，很好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Chóngyánggāo ruǎnruǎn de, nuònuò de, tiántián de, hěn hǎochī.
sentences.english: The Double Ninth cake was soft, glutinous, and sweet; it was delicious.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“奶奶，重阳糕真好吃！”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Nǎinai, Chóngyánggāo zhēn hǎochī!"
sentences.english: Lili said, "Grandma, the Double Ninth cake is really delicious!"

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶说：“好吃就多吃一块。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Hǎochī jiù duō chī yī kuài."
sentences.english: Grandma said, "If it tastes good, have one more piece."

sentences.hanzi: 他们坐在松树下，一边吃糕，一边看山。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zuò zài sōngshù xià, yībiān chī gāo, yībiān kàn shān.
sentences.english: They sat under the pine tree, eating cake and looking at the mountains.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“全家人在一起登高，就是最幸福的事。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye shuō: "Quán jiā rén zài yīqǐ dēnggāo, jiù shì zuì xìngfú de shì."
sentences.english: Grandpa said, "The whole family being together and climbing high is the happiest thing."

sentences.hanzi: 小明点点头说：“明年重阳节，我们还要一起来爬山！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng diǎn diǎn tóu shuō: "Míngnián Chóngyángjié, wǒmen hái yào yīqǐ lái páshān!"
sentences.english: Xiaoming nodded and said, "Next year on the Double Ninth Festival, we will come and climb the mountain together again!"

sentences.hanzi: 大家都笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xiào le.
sentences.english: Everyone laughed.
